notes:
Let given wires in levels follow the player's own chips

The computer levels give wires to REG4, ALU4 and co. that only fit if
the player's chip has its pins where the level author planned them.
The presets now say where that was (pinmap, checked against the model
chips by a test), so a chip made with another pin order gets the given
wires laid anew. While re-laying, the other affected wires stay as
obstacles until their turn - before, a new way could run through a
corner kept by a later wire and short two pins (now tested via the
netlist). Where no way exists the last piece runs slanted.
